ModMetaData.name: Radius UI Framework
ModMetaData.author: astryl
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]◆ Radius UI Framework ◆[/h1] The shared foundation for the Radius UI suite. It carries the design language every Radius UI mod draws with: one colour set, one card and hover treatment, one scrolling widget and one icon family.
This mod adds nothing on its own. Install it because a Radius UI mod asks for it.
[h1]✦ What it provides[/h1] [list] [*][b]One colour set[/b]: a single good / warning / danger ramp and one accent colour, so every panel in the suite means the same thing by the same colour. [*][b]One accent, chosen once[/b]: pick your accent colour here and every Radius UI mod follows it. [*][b]One card style[/b]: the rounded card, border and hover wash that give the suite its look. [*][b]One icon family[/b]: the shared icon set, shipped once instead of copied into every mod. [/list]
[h1]✦ Requirements[/h1] [list] [*][b]Harmony[/b] (brrainz.harmony). [/list]
[hr][/hr] [i]Built for RimWorld 1.6. A library mod: no defs, no world state, settings only.[/i]
